reviewer: Separate read-only reviewer; implementation and integration owned by the parent
verdict: Historical V1-V5 closures retained; no material findings in the optional Moon supplement diff at the current inputs

findings.original: Malformed required fields could trigger exceptions; malformed current receipt rows could silently skip hash checks.
findings.original_evidence: Independent synthetic probes reproduced missing fixture-path KeyError, array artifacts AttributeError and skipped null review input.
findings.resolution: Typed field/container guards and required current hash rows; regression cases retain these negative inputs.

findings.original: NTFS junctions could cause the scanner to read a sibling directory outside the corpus.
findings.original_evidence: Independent synthetic junction probe read an outside canary without a scan error.
findings.resolution: Reject reparse points before traversal and check resolved containment; Windows junction regression covers both reading and receipt output.

findings.original: An output receipt could overwrite an examined public input even when validation failed.
findings.original_evidence: Independent CLI probe overwrote a synthetic README with a failure report.
findings.resolution: Reject public destinations and symlink/junction/hardlink aliases; replace permitted receipts atomically.

findings.original: Contribution identity, publication-commit agreement and nested public evidence references were not checked.
findings.original_evidence: Source-traced dispatcher and record omissions; not a separately reproduced initial end-to-end case.
findings.resolution: Contribution contracts and recursive declared public-reference checks, with mutation regressions.

findings.original: A runtime case could cite an existing file omitted from the hashed manifest; changing that file left selected checks unchanged.
findings.original_evidence: Independent component probe at 18:28:48 UTC returned zero errors before and after changing the unmanifested citation.
findings.resolution: Only successfully hashed normalized manifest paths bind case, subcheck and auxiliary evidence. Omission, mutation, alias and external-source regressions are present.

review_history.result: V1-V4 reported; five completed original-input probes, temporary inputs cleaned up.
Original findings resolved for their scope; runtime citation-binding residual independently reproduced.
Final binding change and its regressions inspected; no material regression found within that change. The later 68-test receipt applies to these historical inputs.

A separate read-only reviewer inspected the two-file optional-supplement diff and matched retained red/green log digests. No material code findings. Exact optional-file dispatch, aggregate counts, original-only minimum, shared duplicate sets and the existing Moon schema were checked; no tests rerun by the reviewer.

verification.scope: 50 focused validator tests passed at the current hashes. The reviewer inspected the completed logs and their digests. The unchanged fixture groups retain separate historical evidence.

historical_verification.scope: 68 combined host tests passed on 2026-11-21 at the prior validator/test hashes recorded in review_history; not a verification of the supplement change.

limitations: Final residual closure is by independent code inspection plus separately recorded parent tests, not a new independent application run.
No exhaustive malformed-input, CommonMark or secret-detection coverage is claimed. Concurrent malicious filesystem mutation is outside the tool's scope.
Matching hashes bind bytes; they do not authenticate an APK publisher or establish the truth of application observations.
The last three citation-binding regressions were added after the independent pre-fix component probe; a pre-fix run of those exact unittest methods was not recorded.
The 2026-11-22 review covers the optional-supplement diff and its synthetic tests, not a new exhaustive review of the whole validator or the integrated research corpus.

The supplement's explicit 50+1 positive assertion was added after its red run. Red and green raw logs were hash-read by the reviewer but unavailable at later integration; retained receipts preserve the observed outcomes.
Optional related_proposal_ids and distinction remain accepted metadata without new semantic validation; semantic proposal review is separately recorded.
